summary: Iter-47 tested end-to-end. Backend GET /api/approvals/pending correctly emits new attribution fields (requester_id, requester_name, center_id_of_request, center_name_of_request, summary.purpose) with graceful null fallback for types missing source data. Frontend /pending-approvals renders new data-testids exactly as spec'd: 129 rows, 48 requester chips (👤 + bold name), 4 center chips (🏢 cyan chip), 74 purpose rows (15px bold), 65 description rows, 101 amount rows (emerald 15px black), 98 FINAL STEP badges. Action dialog header mirrors row layout (👤 requester + bold purpose + emerald amount) — verified by opening the first advance approve dialog. All 6 backend pytest cases green + /api/transactions regression 200.

issues: Pre-existing (NOT introduced by iter-47) React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from the Center/Partner <select> in the payment-attribution block. Cosmetic console warning only; select works. Root cause is x-source instrumentation wrapping option children with <span style=display:contents>. Worth cleaning up in a future iteration by switching to shadcn Select or removing instrumentation on option children.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_pending_approvals — logic is clean and additive; new fields nested under top-level + summary. Consider extracting the ~50-line summary dict into a helper _build_summary(rec, req_type) since server.py is 10k+ lines (file-size code-smell — not blocking).
PendingApprovals.jsx — row layout is well-conditioned (each testid only renders when data exists), which matches the actual counts (48/4/74/65/101 out of 129). Good UX.

Minor: description block uses conditional class string that duplicates the 'bold 15px' style when purpose is absent — this is intentional (description becomes primary) but could be extracted to a variable for readability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_pending_approvals_iter47.py can be re-run any time. Pre-existing <span>-in-<option> hydration warning in payment attribution select is unrelated to iter-47 and safe to ignore until a dedicated cleanup iteration.
